title: Volume 1 units 1450–1489: textual and attribution checks
scope: Volume 1 units 1450–1489; initial checks only. The volume remains incomplete and full-volume rereading is pending.

checks.voice: Signed authorial note by Talleyrand containing a direct quotation of Bonaparte. The literal sweet/salty metaphor and the claim concerning twenty governments are retained; explanation is separate.
The editor corrects the author's 1802 Italian-kingdom claim using inferential wording; this remains distinct from the author's account.

checks.title: Élisa's title princesse de Piombino is a ruling title. The translation and separate gloss convey female sovereignty.
Duroc's grand maréchal du palais is a palace office, distinct from Marshal of France.

checks.continuation: Unit 1477 remains an editorial continuation under note 399, without a new note number.
checks.financial_distinctions: Cash of 1.5 million and immediately payable securities of 92 million remain distinct, as do the treasury and finance ministers.

checks.date_attachment: No external genealogical emendation is certified. The source's date-attachment uncertainty is retained.

checks.territorial_allocations: Bavarian, Württemberg and Baden allocations retain the seven other cities and the distinct part and remainder of Brisgau.
